en.description:
Turn your steps into progress, your workouts into wins, and your goals into a game. Motion is the fitness app that makes staying active fun, consistent, and motivating - no matter your starting point.

Whether you're walking to lose weight, building better habits, or just looking for a more rewarding way to track workouts, Motion helps you stay on track with weekly goals, smart tracking, and gamified fitness challenges.

Consistency is everything, so Motion have built the first motivational AI fitness friend, imagine your most enthusiastic friend, always ready to hype you up, keep you pumped, get you back on track, and super-charge your motivation, so you stay consistent for longer than ever!

# Designed for Everyone, Walkers, Beginners & Busy People
 • Personalised weekly goals that adapt to your fitness level
 • Supports all workouts: walking, running, gym, home, yoga, hiking... if you're moving, it counts!
 • Connects seamlessly to any smart watch, Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin, Withings, Polar, Suunto, and many more

No pressure. No streak anxiety. Just consistent, enjoyable progress.

# Your Fitness, But Make It a Game
 • Adopt an adorable fitness pet in the app, and stay active to keep it happy and healthy
 • Earn Healthy Aura Points from movement to help your Motmot grow
 • Climb the Motioneer Ranks to show-off your progress, and unlock new pets, accessories, awards, and quests
 • Crush weekly goals, win head-to-head activity battles, and join in monthly challenges

# Why Motion Works
 • Personalised, effort-based goals = fair and fun for all fitness levels
 • Weekly goals = rest days without guilt
 • Social accountability = let your friends cheer you on and boost your success
 • Build and emotional connection to your fitness pet, and work hard to keep it happy and healthy

Start moving with Motion today—and fall in love with your fitness routine. Perfect for walking, weight loss, motivation, and making fitness fun again.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Alright, kicking the new year off, we've put a lot of effort into some bugs and performance issues.

Okay, this is a big one! Our new Fit Bingo game has been out for a little while now, so we're ramping it up with some new rewards. From now on, you'll earn Motioneer Experience towards your rank for completing or winning Bingo Quests.

On top of that, we're rolling out a whole series of new rewards you'll unlock every time you reach a new rank. In addition to discovering new types of Motmot as you progress, you'll earn extra rewards, prizes, mystery gifts, quest passes, and even unlock some new features and accessory types very soon!

Keep your activity and metrics front of mind with our overhauled home screen widgets, which now include your Motmot's home background, a simple weekly metrics options, and this week steps chart. They also all now show an indication of when Motion last synced your data, so it's even easier than ever to make sure everything is up-to-date, and you don't miss out on any goals or rewards!

Some cosy little bugs have been sorted out this week too. We should have stopped your micro-pets from moon-walking, double-tapping anywhere on a workout now quick-reacts, store item layout no longer goes all wobbly after you buy a snack, and awards fit properly on iPads too now!

We've been working hard to really try and polish up your experience lately. We've upgraded the animation libraries, which should squash all the little bugs with your Motmots and micro-pets, fixed a number of other bugs.

Even more, to really round off the experience, you can now access Motion right from your wrist on your Apple Watch, keep your weekly progress on your watch face, keep track of your stats, and for the first time ever, you can now log walks and workouts right from the new Motion Apple Watch app. And for those of you without an Apple Watch, Motion can now auto-detect walks for you from your step data, so even if you don't have a tracker, you'll still get the best Motion experience possible!

Alright this is a big one, but no need to panic! We've had a little re-shuffle, and got rid of the Motioneer HQ tab, but fear not, everything you used to find in there has been moved into your main home tab, which, we think makes a lot more sense! This should make it much easier to access the things you need, and crucially, makes some much needed space for some exciting new things we have in the works. You might find a few teasers for things to come hiding around the app too.

We've also had another little tidy up of some of the most pressing issues you've been reporting! So please, do let us know if you spot anything that feels off, of if you can't find anything we might have moved.

Stay happy and healthy!
